target_semantics_lesson: Forecast the monthly copper price return, not just direction. Ensure evidence supports magnitude and boundary crossing for bucketed ranges.
evidence_selection_lesson: Validate causal bridges by ensuring current, cutoff-safe evidence supports every link. Weak links reduce confidence; unknown links invalidate the path.
causal_reasoning_lesson: Test competing causal paths by comparing their current evidence. A stronger mechanism or counter-path may dominate the leading supported path.
counterevidence_lesson: Actively seek counter-evidence. Checkpoints like structural deficits or surpluses can contradict or reverse established causal chains.
calibration_lesson: When assessing commodity prices, integrate sector-specific demand (AI, data centers) with broader industrial signals and global supply/demand.
